source.description_as_supplied: Official 1529 Dioscorides frontispiece; no independent bibliographic acquisition

inspection.native_crop_files: Temporary inspection only, outside project; original unchanged
inspection.selection: Complete illustrated border covered; subsequent detail regions resolve uncertainties rather than select favorable examples

findings.contact_vs_proximity: Grips, branch/talon contact, a carried sprig, muzzle/foliage overlap and paw contact visibly discriminate some attachment from mere proximity. None by itself proves ingestion or therapeutic effect.
findings.woundedness: No securely recognizable piercing projectile, wound, blood or expelled projectile was identified on the antlered quadruped. Thin nearby lines do not license being wounded.
findings.caption_relation: One shrub-side statement plausibly says that its first-person speaker does not breathe for a swine; this is a textual, probably personified relation, not evidence of visible consumption.
findings.source_only_ceiling: No plant species, standard story, therapeutic efficacy or target meaning selected.

statement_cartouches.owner: cock-headed winged composite, by direct position underneath
statement_cartouches.literal_proposed_translation: Let them hate, provided they fear.
statement_cartouches.grammar: Third-person plural subjects unnamed; no second-person addressee identified.
statement_cartouches.certainty: Latin reading high; abbreviated dum expanded explicitly
statement_cartouches.picture_relation: Emblematic attitude; open beak and threatening composite shape do not show an actual attack.

statement_cartouches.owner: round-leaved right-hand shrub, adjacent at its lower-right
statement_cartouches.literal_proposed_translation: Keep away, swine; I do not breathe for you.
statement_cartouches.grammar: Second-person singular imperative plus proposed vocative sue; first-person singular spiro; tibi refers to addressed participant if reading holds.
statement_cartouches.certainty: Abstine/tibi/spiro secure; final letters of sue and barred nō less secure and explicitly provisional. No substitution from a remembered proverb.
statement_cartouches.pictured_addressee: No secure pictured swine–shrub attachment; neighboring animal identities do not settle addressee.
statement_cartouches.picture_relation: Shrub ownership supports personified speaker as hypothesis. Neither literal plant breathing nor beneficial/harmful odor can be visually verified.

scientific_consequence.positive: Source offers observable typed contacts and a provisional explicit speaker/addressee/negation statement; those constrain a source reading more than proximity alone.
scientific_consequence.negative: Consumption, woundedness and therapeutic effect cannot be treated as observed facts. Greek cartouches and the exact Latin vocative/negation require source-text adjudication before a fixed caption relation is used.
scientific_consequence.target_decision: No target admission, target semantic binding or independent confirmation arises from this audit.
